title: Recurrent - Which electric vehicles have heat pumps?
notes: US list. Heat pump yes: LYRIQ 2023+, OPTIQ 2025+, ESCALADE IQ 2025+, VISTIQ 2026+, Blazer EV/Equinox EV/Silverado EV 2024+, Bolt 2027+, HUMMER EV Pickup/SUV 2022+, Sierra EV 2024+ (all trims; standard/optional not labelled). No: Bolt EV and Bolt EUV (2017-2023) and Spark EV.
